# EcoSend
EcoSend is a sustainable email marketing platform designed for purpose-driven organizations. It offers a range of powerful tools for creating impactful email campaigns while minimizing environmental impact. The platform focuses on features that promote ethical marketing practices, analytics, and a commitment to reducing carbon footprints through automatic tree planting for each email sent.
## About Us
The mission of EcoSend is to transform email marketing into a sustainable and positive channel for change. EcoSend operates on principles of responsibility, valuing every email's impact on time, energy, and attention.
### Core Values
- **Email isn’t free.** Every email carries a cost in time, energy, and attention.
- **Act now, not tomorrow.** Swift action is essential for success.
- **Simple over simple enough.** Advocating for simplicity to avoid chaos.
- **Details make the product.** Small elements contribute significantly to the overall quality.
- **Prioritize our customer's customer.** Meeting their needs is crucial for success.
## Features
EcoSend provides a wide array of features aimed at enhancing email marketing efforts:
### 1. Lightning-fast Deliverability
- 99.9% uptime guarantee
- Real-time delivery monitoring
- Advanced spam prevention
### 2. Smart Segmentation
- Behavioral segmentation
- Engagement-based groups
- Custom segment creation
### 3. Carbon Offset Integration
- Automatic carbon offsetting
- Environmental impact dashboard
- Verified offset projects
### 4. Green Infrastructure
- Powered by 100% renewable energy
- Energy-efficient architecture
### 5. Privacy-First Design
- GDPR compliance tools
- Data encryption and privacy policy templates
### 6. Advanced Analytics
- Comprehensive campaign performance metrics
- Real-time reporting analytics
### 7. Smart Automation
- Intuitive workflow builder for email automation
- Dynamic content capabilities
### 8. Email Template Builder
- Drag-and-drop email creation
- Responsive templates
## Pricing
EcoSend offers competitive pricing plans to suit different organizational needs, starting with a free trial for new users.
## Blog and Resources
The platform provides access to a wealth of knowledge on digital marketing through podcasts, newsletters, and a comprehensive glossary.
### Links
- [Marketing Glossary](https://ecosend.io/glossary)
- [Podcast](https://ecosend.io/podcast)
- [Email Carbon Calculator](https://ecosend.io/carbon-calculator/)
## Customer Stories
EcoSend proudly collaborates with a diverse range of organizations, such as:
- **B Lab Europe**: Adopted EcoSend for its alignment with sustainable practices.
- **Better Business Network**: Migrated due to EcoSend's capabilities and support.
## Sustainability Commitment
EcoSend is dedicated to:
- Operating with minimal carbon footprint through renewable energy sources.
- Offsetting emissions by planting trees and supporting verified projects.
- Educating users on the environmental impact of their email marketing activities.
## Support
The support center provides resources and guidance for users to maximize their experience with EcoSend.
To get started with EcoSend, organizations can sign up for a [free trial](https://ecosend.io/plans) and join in on the mission to make email a force for good.

Features
Powerful features for sustainable growth.
Powerful email marketing tools, sustainable practices, and a platform that's built to help you succeed.
Get Started for Free
No credit card required. Cancel anytime.
Trusted by purpose-driven organisations around the world.
 
Email Builder
A delightful email builder
A modern editing experience that's calm and focused. Craft stunning, attention-grabbing emails with ease — and let Review Mode catch spelling, accessibility, and compliance issues before you send.
More about the email builder 
 
Deliverability
Our infrastructure is optimised for maximum email deliverability. We use advanced algorithms and real-time monitoring to ensure your emails reach inboxes reliably and quickly.
 
Smart segmentation
Create highly targeted campaigns with our advanced segmentation tools. Understand your audience better and deliver personalised emails that resonate.
 
Automatic climate action
Just by using EcoSend, you'll be making a positive climate impact. Every email campaign automatically contributes to verified climate action projects.
 
Green infrastructure
Our platform runs on renewable energy and is optimised for minimal environmental impact. We believe in sustainable growth that doesn't compromise on performance.
 
Privacy-first
Built with subscriber trust at the core. We help you maintain GDPR compliance and respect user privacy while driving engagement.
 
Advanced analytics
Get deep insights into your campaign performance with our comprehensive analytics dashboard. Make data-driven decisions to improve engagement.
 
Smart automation
Create sophisticated email workflows that nurture your subscribers and drive conversions. Set it and forget it with our powerful automation tools.
Everything you need
All the features you need to run successful email marketing campaigns.
Core Features
 
Email Capture Forms
GDPR-compliant, accessible, responsive email capture forms to build your audience.
 
Email Templates
Beautiful, responsive email templates crafted by professional designers to get you started.
 
Human Support
Dedicated hands-on support from our UK-based expert team.
 
List Management
Advanced subscriber list management.
 
Scheduled Sending
Schedule emails to send at specific times.
 
Custom Domains
Use your own domain for sending emails.
 
API Access
Full API access for custom integrations.
Composition
 
Simple Email
Beautifully minimal, optimised-for-mobile default email templates.
 
Drag-and-Drop Email Builder
Create beautiful, responsive emails with our drag-and-drop editor. No coding required, just drag, drop, and send.
 
Automatic Image Optimisation
Every image is automatically resized, reformatted, and compressed — so emails load faster, with zero extra work.
 
Inline Image Editing
Crop, rotate, flip, and style images right in the email builder — no separate tools or re-uploads.
 
Review Mode
Automatic checks for spelling, grammar, accessibility, and compliance issues — with one-click fixes before you send. No AI, all done privately on your device.
 
Saved Blocks
Save and reuse your favourite content for faster, more consistent email creation.
 
Template Gallery
Access our growing library of beautiful, accessible, and low-carbon free email templates.
 
Real-time Variables
Use real-time variables to personalise your emails and create dynamic content.
 
Markdown Support
Write your emails in Markdown to reliably and efficiently format your content.
 
Custom HTML Email
Create email templates with custom HTML and CSS.
Growth
 
Inline Forms
Grow your audience with inline forms that convert visitors into subscribers.
 
Pop-Up Forms
Grow your audience with pop-up forms that display at the perfect moment.
 
Hosted Forms
Share your forms with a simple link. Build your audience on any platform without writing code.
 
Manually Add Subscribers
Add subscribers manually to any list via the dashboard.
Automation
 
Automated Workflows
Create complex email automation sequences.
 
Drip Campaigns
Create drip campaigns to nurture your audience over time.
 
Scheduled Campaigns
Create scheduled campaigns to send at specific times.
Analytics
 
Advanced Analytics
Detailed performance metrics so you can see how your campaigns are performing.
 
Campaign Tracking
Track email campaign performance.
Sustainability
 
Climate Conscious Email
Send emails with minimal environmental impact.
 
Climate Impact Tracking
Monitor and report on the climate impact of using EcoSend with tree count and CO2e numbers.
 
Automated Tree Planting
Trees are automatically planted based on your plan to contribute to reforestation projects and help restore the planet.
Compliance and Deliverability
 
GDPR Compliant
Built-in tools to help you maintain GDPR compliance.
 
Double Opt-in
Ensure you build an audience of real people, not bots by requiring new subscribers to confirm their email address.
 
One-click Unsubscribe
Make it easy for your contacts to unsubscribe from your emails with a one-click link.
 
Cyber Essentials Certified
Certified by the UK government's Cyber Essentials scheme for robust cybersecurity practices.
Account Management
 
Teams
Collaborate with your team with additional users, for free.
 
Multi-factor Authentication
Protect your account with multi-factor authentication.
Integrations
 
Zapier Integration
Connect EcoSend with 5,000+ apps and automate your workflows with Zapier.
 
Gravity Forms Integration
Seamlessly integrate with Wordpress via Gravity Forms to capture leads and automatically add them to your email lists.
 
Mailchimp Import
Easily migrate your subscribers, lists, and campaign data from Mailchimp to EcoSend.
Latest updates
What we've been shipping.
EcoSend moves quickly. Here's a snapshot of recent releases — see the full changelog for everything we've been working on.
6 Aug 2026
Inline image editing
30 Jul 2026
Review Mode — EcoSend now catches grammar, spelling, accessibility, and compliance issues for you
28 Jul 2026
Easier block selection, image resizing, and alt tags
23 Jul 2026
Automatic image optimisation
See the full changelog 
What we stand for
Better email starts with better values.
Honesty, accessibility, ethics, and sustainability aren't marketing lines for us — they're how we build every feature in the editor.
 
Honesty
Straightforward pricing. Export your HTML anytime. No dark patterns, no surprise fees, no pretending we're something we're not.
 
Accessibility
Everyone should be able to receive, read, and act on the emails you send. Sensible defaults, semantic markup, and guidance built into every block.
 
Ethics
Independently owned and B Corp certified. Privacy-first by design, GDPR-ready tools, and an ethical policy on who we serve.
 
Sustainability
Renewable-powered infrastructure, lean email code, automatic image compression, and verified nature restoration with every campaign.
